entities.summary: The St. Nicholas Cathedral also called St. Nicholas of Bari Cathedral is the cathedral of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Đà Lạt, suffragan of the Archdiocese of Ho Chi Minh City, located in Da Lat, the capital of Lam Dong province in the Central Highlands of Vietnam.
